Welcome to TRUE Horses Channel!

Subscribe►https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCHEdKUuIw-cEYhaSphK6Jfw?sub_confirmation=1

This is the place for those who love horses, dressage and equestrianism as much as we do. 

I am Valeriya - international dressage rider and Founder of TRUE Horses, a company that produces dressage sport horses of excellent quality and readability, ensuring top health and no overpricing. We are currently based between the UK & the Netherlands so if you are looking for a horse or want to get lesson or anything else - feel free to contact us:

info@truehorses.com

Visit our website to see our beautiful horses and read about our breeding programme: 

https://www.truehorses.com/

Follow us on 
Instagram: @true.horses
Don't forget to subscribe: Subscribe►https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCHEdKUuIw-cEYhaSphK6Jfw?sub_confirmation=1

Lots of love,Yours TRUE Horses 💚

#dressagehorse #equestrian #grandprixhorse #horse #truehorses #equestrianlifestyle
